title: Northgate Rewards Visa Business Cardholder Terms: Share of the Route Pickup Fee
content:
Cardholder benefit terms for the route pickup fee invoiced by Northgate Purchases & Returns on the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise for a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership. The benefit turns on how the purchase was paid and on the Northgate Credit Cards business card the member holds active.

## Route pickup cardholder share

When the purchase was paid with the Northgate Visa and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus, the route pickup fee is half of the sum; when the purchase was paid with the Northgate Visa and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Business, or the purchase was paid with any other tender and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus, the route pickup fee is three quarters of the sum; otherwise the route pickup fee is the full sum.

The sum is every charge making up the route pickup fee, added together; the share (0.5, 0.75 or 1) is applied once to that whole sum, and only the resulting route pickup fee is rounded half up to the cent. The tender is the purchase's recorded primary tender; the card is the Northgate Credit Cards account in status active held by the member.

| Purchase tender | Active business card held | Share of the sum |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Visa | Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 0.5 (half) |
| Northgate Visa | Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 0.75 (three quarters) |
| any other tender | Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 0.75 (three quarters) |
| any other tender | Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 1 (full sum) |
| any tender | neither card active | 1 (full sum) |

## Worked share (hypothetical sum)

On a sum of 147.00, a half share gives 73.50; a three-quarter share gives 110.25; the full sum stays 147.00. On a sum of 133.30, a three-quarter share gives 99.975, rounded half up to 99.98.
